options.title: India ki sabse lambi border kis desh se lagti hai? 🇮🇳
options.first_line: भारत की सबसे लंबी ज़मीनी सीमा किस पड़ोसी देश से लगती है?
options.first_frame: India's map with its neighbours dimmed around it, a bright line already running along India's land border.

options.title: China ya Pakistan? India ki sabse lambi border kiske saath?
options.first_line: चीन या पाकिस्तान, भारत की सबसे लंबी सीमा किसके साथ है?
options.first_frame: India in the middle with China's and Pakistan's flags filling them on either side, a question mark between them.

options.title: Bharat ke padosi: sabse lambi seema kiske saath? 🗺️
options.first_line: भारत के पड़ोसी चारों तरफ़ हैं, पर सबसे लंबी सीमा किसके साथ?
options.first_frame: India's neighbours lighting up one after another round its map, each with its flag.

why: Naming the two neighbours every Indian already argues about turns the question into a guess the viewer makes in the first second, and neither the title nor the first frame gives away the answer, so they have to stay to find out who wins.
